predecessors.name: Thirtieth Dynasty of Egypt
predecessors.text: Egypt, conquered by Artaxerxes III in 343

successors.name: Kingdom of Macedon
successors.text: Egypt, handed over by Mazaces to Alexander the Great in 332

ledger.x: 343: Artaxerxes III reconquers Egypt and the Thirty-first Dynasty begins.
343: Egypt is held again by the Persian kings as the Second Egyptian Satrapy (343-332).
338: Khababash revolts in Upper Egypt and declares himself pharaoh; the table says he "Led a revolt against Persian rule in Upper Egypt, declared himself Pharaoh" (338–335).
335: Upper Egypt is recovered: the table says "Upper Egypt returned to Persian control in 335 BC".
332: Persian rule over Egypt ends with Alexander's arrival (the page: "was disestablished upon the conquest of Egypt by Alexander the Great").
332: the Thirty-first Dynasty ends; Alexander the Great holds Egypt, which the Ptolemies take as their kingdom from 331.

wars.name: Artaxerxes III's reconquest of Egypt
wars.outcome: Persian victory in 343 after a failed attempt about 351; Nectanebo II was beaten near Pelusium and fled to Ethiopia (Nubia); Artaxerxes III razed the walls, looted the temples and appointed Pherendates satrap.

wars.name: Revolt of Khababash
wars.outcome: Khababash held Upper Egypt as pharaoh for three years; it returned to Persian control in 335.

wars.name: Alexander's conquest of Egypt
wars.outcome: No fighting: Mazaces handed Egypt over in 332.

certainty.note: No frontier is given; only Egypt, Lower and Upper Egypt are named.
